Fees shown in the Fee Schedule are exclusive of the 6% Service Tax. The Service Tax rate and taxable fee components are subject to change as determined by government regulations.

programmes.officialAcademicRequirement: Entry Requirements Ready to take the next step in your academic journey? Our programme offers an exciting opportunity for individuals passionate about the field of Architecture. To ensure a smooth admission process, please take note of our entry requirements listed below. Prerequisites SPM/O-level or equivalent A pass in SPM/O-level or equivalent with 5 credits, including Mathematics. (Except for UEC) Pass an Interview and Aptitude Assessment (AA) Note : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university. Entry Pathway AUSMAT (SACEi) Min. ATAR 70 A Level Min. CDD excluding General Paper or studies in student’s first language Note: any combination of grade but not lower than Grade D Canadian Pre-University (CPU) Min. average of 65% in 6 subjects Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan Malaysia (STPM) Min. CGPA 2.67 in 3 subjects Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) Pass in UEC with Min. 5Bs including Mathematics (Note: Candidates without a Grade ‘B’ in Mathematics subject may be admitted if the candidate has a credit in Mathematic subject at SPM or equivalent level) Taylor's Foundation in Design (FID) Pass with min. CGPA 2.00 Taylor's Foundation in Natural and Built Environments (FNBE) Pass with min. CGPA 2.00 (not subject to interview and AA) Other Taylor's Foundation in related field Pass with min. description.en: The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Architecture, accredited by the Board of Architects Malaysia (Lembaga Arkitek Malaysia or LAM), is a pre-professional degree programme exempting graduates from the LAM Part I Examination. A consistently sought-after programme, this degree is ideal for students committed to shaping the future of the built environment. You'll acquire comprehensive theoretical knowledge and practical skills through a curriculum that nurtures your creativity, critical thinking, and technical expertise. Upon completion of the programme, you graduate as an Assistant Architect, equipped to contribute under registered practitioners, while pursuing further professional training.

curriculum.en: Explore Taylor's industry-focused curriculum, designed to equip you with robust skills for thriving in today's rapidly changing environment. Below is an overview of what you can expect from this programme's structure.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which are common modules across a discipline that provides the fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Architectural Design I; Architecture History and Theory; Design Communication; Architectural Design II; Asian Architecture; Building Construction and Materials; Architecture and Environment; Year 2; Architectural Design III; Computer Applications; Architectural Design IV; Building Services; Year 3; Architectural Design V; Advanced Architectural Construction; Architectural Design Project; Architectural Project Management; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; University Core; This component aims to develop critical thinking, build up social intelligence and cultivate civic responsibility as well as broaden cultural knowledge. It consists of compulsory and nationally mandated study modules required by the Malaysian Ministry of Higher Education.; Penghayatan Etika dan Peradaban / Bahasa Melayu Komunikasi 2; Falsafah dan Isu Semasa; Emotional Intelligence in Action; Kursus Integriti dan Antirasuah; Social Innovation Project; Note; :; Students are requested to take Bahasa Kebangsaan A if they do not obtain a Credit for Bahasa Malaysia in SPM.; All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Flexible Education; The Flexible Education component offers students the flexibility to explore modules in a related or unrelated field, enhancing and complementing their primary major. This component allows students to broaden their knowledge and skills by selecting modules from the same or different schools within the university.; Flexible Education can take various forms, including free electives, extensions, minors, or even a second major. These options provide students with the opportunity to delve deeper into a specific area of interest or broaden their understanding by exploring a different field of study.; Click here to see a full list of all available Flexible Education Components.; You will need to choose one of the packages below.

description.en: The Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Interior Architecture programme is meticulously structured to provide you with a comprehensive education in the field. The programme consists of up to 123 credit units, including a dedicated 12-credit industrial training component, so you gain both academic depth and valuable workplace exposure. Ideal for students aiming to enter the interior architecture field with a strong, recognised foundation, this degree is a preferred choice for those drawn to human-centred design careers. Aligning with the degree programme requirements set by the Board of Architects Malaysia or Lembaga Arkitek Malaysia (LAM), the regulatory body for the Architecture and Interior Architecture/Design professions in Malaysia, our curriculum meets Malaysia's highest standards for interior architecture education.

curriculum.en: The Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Interior Architecture encourages collaboration with disciplines such as architecture, landscape design, and the creation of expressive spaces in the public realm. By exploring these interdisciplinary connections, our programme provides a unique and enriching educational experience. Our curriculum is designed to equip you with a comprehensive understanding of interior architecture, while also encouraging you to explore innovative ideas and push the boundaries of design.; This degree programme is compatible with the; Taylor's Curriculum Framework; that allows students to mix & match study modules.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which are common modules across a discipline that provide fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Interior Architecture Design I; Design Communication; Interior Structure and Construction; Narrative Media; Interior Architecture Design II; Digital Modeling and Visualisation; Material and Finishes; Architecture History and Theory; UCM 2; Year 2; Interior Architecture Design III; Building Science and Services; Interior Architecture Design IV; Detailing and Working Drawing; Chooose Extension Package or Elective Modules; Year 3; Internship Reflective Practice**; Internship Practical Report**; Advanced Interior Architecture Design I; Advanced Interior Architecture Design II; Professional Practice; ** 6 Months Internship Experience in local or abroad assisted by Taylor's Career Services and supervised by Registered Interior/Architect or equivalent.; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; University Core; This component aims to develop critical thinking, build up social intelligence and cultivate civic responsibility as well as broaden cultural knowledge. It consists of compulsory and nationally-mandated study modules required by the Malaysian Ministry of Higher Education.; Penghayatan Etika dan Peradaban / Bahasa Melayu Komunikasi 2; Falsafah dan Isu Semasa; Emotional Intelligence in Action; Kursus Integriti dan Antirasuah; Social Innovation Project; Note

description.en: Our Bachelor of Quantity Surveying programme offers a recognised qualification and serves as a stepping stone towards becoming a Registered Quantity Surveyor—a pivotal role within the construction industry. Students automatically become members of the Board of Quantity Surveyors Malaysia (BQSM), a widely recognised professional body. This affiliation not only validates your expertise but also provides you with access to a vast network spanning over 140 countries through the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS). Additionally, our programme is accredited by the Pacific Association of Quantity Surveyors (PAQS), further enhancing its credibility and value. Highly regarded in the industry, the programme continues to attract demand from students pursuing careers in contract administration and sustainable procurement.
description.ms: Our Bachelor of Quantity Surveying programme offers a recognised qualification and serves as a stepping stone towards becoming a Registered Quantity Surveyor—a pivotal role within the construction industry. Students automatically become members of the Board of Quantity Surveyors Malaysia (BQSM), a widely recognised professional body. This affiliation not only validates your expertise but also provides you with access to a vast network spanning over 140 countries through the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS). Additionally, our programme is accredited by the Pacific Association of Quantity Surveyors (PAQS), further enhancing its credibility and value. Highly regarded in the industry, the programme continues to attract demand from students pursuing careers in contract administration and sustainable procurement.

description.en: Our Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Sustainable Digital Construction Management programme responds directly to the growing demand for future-ready skilled construction managers in Malaysia and globally. One of the few programmes of its kind in the region, it attracts high-calibre students who want to be part of a new era in construction. The programme addresses sustainability challenges in the construction industry, with an emphasis on Smart and Green Construction practices. Our comprehensive curriculum leverages a Work-based Learning track featuring a year-long industry placement, bridging academic learning with hands-on experience. Aligning with the government's strategic plan, Construction 4.0, the programme incorporates Building Information Modeling (BIM), preparing you to support the national goal of BIM adoption across 80% of construction projects by 2025.

curriculum.en: The Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Sustainable Digital Construction Management is multidisciplinary, collaborative and technology-driven and provides better opportunities for students' successful careers in the ASEAN Economic Community industry. The programme is uniquely dedicated to developing construction project managers’ knowledge and expertise in sustainable construction by drawing upon subject expertise within the School of Architecture, Building and Design and other schools in Taylor’s University. The programme focuses on challenges that the built environment faces today and the impact and importance of creating a resilient built environment and digitised construction project management.; It addresses critical global challenges by integrating contemporary construction management theory and practice with fundamental and interrelated sustainable design and construction theory and practice. The programme will expose students to multidisciplinary teamwork, focused on the integration of green and smart design, and construction processes across a building life cycle through collaborative practices emphasising the practical application of sustainability within the programme.; This degree programme is compatible with the; Taylor's Curriculum Framework; that allows students to mix & match study modules.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which are common modules across a discipline that provides the fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Construction Management and Safety; Construction Technology I; Building Information Modelling I; Building Services; Construction Environmental Protection Management; Site Management; Construction Planning and Scheduling; Construction Technology II; Year 2; Construction Law and Dispute Resolution; Construction Measurement and Estimating; Cash Flow Management and Construction Economics; Construction Research Project I; Tendering Management and Contract Administration; Year 3; Internship; Construction Research Project II; Construction Quality Management / (WBL); Industry Project I (WBL); Industry Project II (WBL); Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Specialisations; You will need to choose one of the options below:; Green Construction; Internet of Things in Construction; Construction Simulation Project / (WBL); Green Technology and Construction; Innovative Construction Materials; SMART Building Systems; Smart Construction

description.en: Master of Architecture is a postgraduate programme designed to elevate your architectural career through coursework. This prestigious professional degree programme holds the same equivalency as the LAM Part II Examination of the Board of Architects (LAM), and is a continuation of the Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Architecture, following the qualification achieved through LAM Part I. Each intake welcomes a select cohort of students, ensuring you benefit from focused support, graduating with a deep understanding of architecture and the built environment. With an emphasis on theoretical knowledge and practical application, this degree prepares you to advance confidently towards registration as a Professional Architect with LAM.

description.en: Our programme gives you specialist expertise in digital-enabled design and construction projects, while integrating sophisticated technologies relevant to industrial practice. You'll master key innovations like Building Information Modelling (BIM), Virtualisation and Extended Reality, Autonomous Construction, Predictive Analysis, Cloud and Realtime Collaboration through hands-on learning in our dedicated laboratories and virtual environment facilities. With limited cohort sizes, you'll work closely with faculty experts while developing skills tailored to the needs of the ASEAN Economic Community industry. This focused approach ensures you graduate ready to lead in the competitive and fast-evolving construction sector.

curriculum.en: The Master of Science in Virtual Design and Construction is an integrated, multidisciplinary and technology-driven postgraduate programme which provides diversified opportunities for the student’s successful career in the Architecture Engineering and Construction (ASEAN Economic Community) industry.; The programme will combine internationally renowned academic and industry expertise with intensive practical learning, using state-of-the-art technologies within the university's dedicated computer laboratories and virtual environment facilities. As the nature of the built environment is diverse and multidisciplinary, the topics and contents covered in the programme are suitable and flexible for all industrial players within the built environment.; Core Modules; You will need to choose 1 module from the list below:; Construction Process and Practice; Information Management and Building Information Modelling; Change Management in Construction Digitalisation; Integrated Project I; Integrated Project II; Dissertation I; Dissertation II; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Specialisations; You will need to choose one of the below:; Specialisation 1: Digital Design; Digital Construction Estimation and Scheduling; Performance Based Design and Simulation; Parametric Modelling and Design Prototyping; Specialisation 2: Virtual Construction; Simulated Construction Planning and Control; Virtual Environment and Interactive technology; Advanced Technologies in Construction

programmes.officialAcademicRequirement: Entry Requirements We offer two entry pathways for this PhD programme, which are normal mode and prior to publication mode. Our PhD by Prior Publication mode provides a unique pathway for you to achieve a Doctoral award based on your existing body of work. We recognise the value of your prior publications and include them as a significant part of your submission for the Doctoral award. Normal Mode Master's A Master's Degree (Malaysian Qualification Framework, Level 6) or equivalent (accepted by HEP) in Architecture or related field. Applications are admitted who meet the course requirements and whose research interests match those of an available member of the doctoral faculty. Interview & Review Candidates are required to submit a statement of purpose of their motivation for engaging in this programme of study. Qualified applicants may be invited to interview with a member of the doctoral faculty. English Requirement
programmes.officialLanguageRequirement: International students must have proof of good proficiency in verbal and written English: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) score of 6.0 or its equivalent. The validity of the IELTS or equivalent is within 2 years from the date of the examination. Accelerated PhD Programme Bachelor's degree candidates who are registered for master's degree programmes may apply to convert to the doctoral degree programmes subjected to the following conditions: Within 1 year for full time and within 2 years for part-time candidates Having shown competency and capability in conducting research at doctoral level through rigorous internal evaluation Approval of the Taylor's University Senate If Your Bachelor's Degree is from a Different Field Students without a qualification in the related fields or relevant working experience are required to undergo and pass a bridging module. Note : Any of the condition of the above would require student's research proposal to be approved. All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university. Prior Publication Mode You will need to fulfil one of the below: Obtain a master's degree in the field or related fields accepted by the HEP Senate Obtain other qualifications equivalent to a master's degree recognised by the Government of Malaysia Candidates without a related qualification in the field/s or working experience in the relevant fields must undergo appropriate prerequisite courses determined by the HEP In addition to the above criteria, those who want to join Doctoral Degree by Retrospective or Prior Publication mode must include the below to the formal application: Minimum of 5 publications or equivalent works in alignment with the theme of the specialisation; An executive summary of the above publications to demonstrate the applicant’s contribution to knowledge in the field; A list of scholarly published work; The minimum language proficiency of the candidates must be determined by the HEP consistent with applicable programme standards or based on the needs of the programme, i.e., learning outcomes and the medium of instruction. A Selection Committee must be established to review the formal application for PhD by Retrospective or Prior Publication and recommend to the Senate to obtain approval. Criteria for published works Published work must encompass high-quality journals, monographs, books, research-based chapters in books, electronic publications which have not been used to obtain other awards or deemed a part of those awards. The publications or productions must be published or produced within a period not exceeding ten (10) years from the date of submission. For the five (5) nominated publications or productions, the candidate must be the principal author or creator with the contributions of others clearly defined. Notes All information is subject to change. The above entry requirements serve as a guideline. Readers are responsible to verify the information by contacting the university's Admissions Department. description.en: Our PhD in Architecture programme provides a platform for you to delve deep into your chosen research areas, pushing the boundaries of architectural understanding and practice. As a doctoral candidate, you will work closely with your advisors to develop and execute a research project of substantial scope and significance. While not a licensure programme, the Doctor of Philosophy (Architecture) offers extensive opportunities, producing scholars whose work shapes policy and practice across Asia. With only a select few admitted each year, you'll join a tight-knit community of researchers who are passionate about driving innovation in the field through critical analysis and the generation of new insights.

description.en: The Bachelor of Biomedical Science (Honours) at Taylor’s University provides a strong foundation in human biology, health, and disease. The programme integrates theory with hands-on laboratory experience, preparing you to tackle modern biomedical challenges. Study core areas including physiology, pathology, molecular biology, genetics, and pharmacology. Through practical laboratory work and research projects, you will learn to translate scientific concepts into real-world solutions. With guidance from experienced faculty and exposure to the latest technologies, graduate ready to launch a career in in biomedical research, healthcare, or the broader life science industry.

curriculum.en: The Bachelor of Biomedical Science (Honours) programme combines core biomedical knowledge with applicable skills. You will study:; Anatomy & Physiology; Pathology & Microbiology; Molecular Biology & Genetics; Pharmacology & Toxicology; Research & Laboratory Training; This balanced approach ensures you gain both scientific knowledge and the practical abilities needed for a career in biomedical science.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which are common modules across a discipline that provides the fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Basic Anatomy with Histology and Heamatology; Basic Pharmacology and Toxicology with Health Informatics; Introduction to Microbiology; Principles of Biochemistry; Human Physiology; Advanced Pharmacology; Clinical Chemistry; Human Pathology; Instrumentation in Medical Diagnostic, Laboratory Science and Blood Banking; Epidemiology, Public Health and Bioethics, Biostatistics; Year 2; Medical Parasitology; Medical Microbiology; Immunoloy; Applications of Bioinformatics; Clinical Genetics; Biomedical Practicum (Hospital Attachment module); Year 3; Research and Laboratory Management; Research Project; Nutritional Biochemistry; Applied Nutrition; Community Nutrition; Industrial Training; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; University Core; This component aims to develop critical thinking, build up social intelligence and cultivate civic responsibility as well as broaden cultural knowledge. These consist of compulsory and nationally-mandated study modules required by the Malaysian Ministry of Higher Education.; Penghayatan Etika dan Peradaban / Bahasa Melayu Komunikasi 2

description.en: With global population growth intensifying food scarcity concerns, our programme emphasises the crucial role of innovation in shaping sustainable food systems. Through impactful research and experiential learning, gain practical know-how to develop environmentally responsible products and improve access to safe, nutritious food. Embark on a transformative journey with our sought-after Bachelor of Food Science (Honours) programme, crafted for those passionate about promoting health and sustainability through food. You'll master food processing, safety, nutrition, and sensory evaluation through hands-on learning in our specialised labs. Join us in pioneering solutions that safeguard our planet's future while nourishing communities worldwide.

curriculum.en: We will delve into the science behind food processing, exploring the various techniques and methods used in transforming raw ingredients into finished food products. You will learn about the principles of food preservation, packaging, and quality control, ensuring that you have a comprehensive understanding of the entire food production process.; This programme is compatible with the new Taylor's Curriculum Framework that allows students to mix & match study modules.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which are common modules across a discipline that provides the fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Introduction to Food Science & Nutrition; Fundamentals of Chemistry; Introduction to Microbiology; Cell Biology; Principles of Biochemistry; Food Chemistry; Food Physics; Food Microbiology; Introduction to Biostatistics; Year 2; Food & Nutrients Evaluation; Techniques in Food/Nutrition Research; Food Processing; Food Preservation; Food Product Development; Sensory Evaluation; Food Safety & Quality Management; Year 3; Research Project; Industrial Training; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; University Core; This component aims to develop critical thinking, build up social intelligence and cultivate civic responsibility as well as broaden cultural knowledge. These consist of compulsory and nationally-mandated study modules required by the Malaysian Ministry of Higher Education.; Social Innovation Project; Falsafah dan Ibu Semasa; Emotional Intelligence in Action; Kursus Integriti Dan Antirasuah; Penghayatan Etika dan Peradaban / Bahasa Melayu Komunikasi 2; Note; :; Students are requested to take Bahasa Kebangsaan A if they do not obtain a Credit for Bahasa Malaysia in SPM.; All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Flexible Education

description.en: The industry-recognised Bachelor of Biotechnology (Honours) programme is designed to provide you with a comprehensive education and training across agriculture, medical, and industrial biotechnology: three core areas driving scientific innovation. Through our progressive curriculum, dive into fascinating topics such as molecular cloning, genome editing, cell tissue culture techniques, bioinformatics analysis, bioprocessing technologies, and research and development techniques and instrumentation. You'll also gain real-world experience through hands-on sessions, learning to apply classroom concepts in laboratory settings. We advise early applications for students seeking to lead in this high-demand field, where graduates are increasingly sought after by multinational firms and research institutions.

curriculum.en: As a student in our programme, you will have the opportunity to explore a wide range of essential components in the field of biotechnology. We will expose you to scientific principles and knowledge that serve as the foundation of this discipline. You will gain a deep understanding of the fundamental concepts and theories that drive advancements in biotechnology.; In addition, you will be introduced to bioinformatics technologies, which play a critical role in analysing and interpreting biological data. Through hands-on experiences and practical applications, you will develop the necessary skills to leverage computational tools and techniques for data analysis in the biotechnology field.; This programme is compatible with the new Taylor's Curriculum Framework that allows students to mix & match study modules.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which are common modules across a discipline that provides the fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Introduction to Biotechnology; Fundamentals of Chemistry; Introduction to Microbiology; Cell Biology; Principles of Biochemistry; Principle of Genetics; Molecules from Nature: Biodiversity and Natural Products; Techniques and Instrumentation in Biotechnology; Introduction to Biostatistics; Year 2; Crop Biotechnology; Animal Biotechnology; Bioprocess Technology; Applications of Bioinformatics; Research and Laboratory Management; Trends in Applied and Synthetic Biotechnology; Understanding Entrepreneurialism; Year 3; Research Project; Industrial Training; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; University Core; This component aims to develop critical thinking, build up social intelligence and cultivate civic responsibility as well as broaden cultural knowledge. These consist of compulsory and nationally-mandated study modules required by the Malaysian Ministry of Higher Education.; Penghayatan Etika dan Peradaban / Bahasa Melayu Komunikasi 2; Falsafah dan Isu Semasa; Emotional Intelligence in Action; Kursus Integriti Dan Antirasuah; Social Innovation Project; Note; :; Students are requested to take Bahasa Kebangsaan A if they do not obtain a Credit for Bahasa Malaysia in SPM.; All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.

description.en: Introducing our new Applied Health Sciences degree with specialisations, as the first of its kind in Malaysia to offer specialisations in four unique areas. This innovative programme is designed to equip you with essential knowledge and skills to shape the future of healthcare and positively impact global health. Our curriculum nurtures competent professionals, emphasising practical applications in applied health sciences research, applied health sciences practice, and entrepreneurship. With our comprehensive curriculum and specialisations, acquire the expertise needed to thrive in various applied health science fields. Neuroscience

curriculum.en: The Applied Health Sciences degree programme is designed to equip you with a comprehensive and nuanced understanding of diverse applied health sciences disciplines to ensure enhanced employability and your readiness for success in this field. Starting with a solid foundation in basic applied health sciences, the programme guides you on a systematic journey toward mastery through specialised modules.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which are common modules across a discipline that provides fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Cell Biology; Fundamentals of Chemistry; Introduction to Microbiology; Human Anatomy and Physiology; Basic Pharmacology and Toxicology with Health Informatics; Principles of Biochemistry; Principles of Genetics; Year 2; Introduction to Biostatistics; Science Communication and Ethics; Design, Data and Decisions; Year 3; Research Project; Understanding Entrepreneurialism; Industrial Attachment; Note; :; This programme does not grant Malaysian Allied Health Professions Council (MPKBM) registration.; All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; University Core; This component aims to develop critical thinking, build up social intelligence, and cultivate civic responsibility as well as broaden cultural knowledge. It consists of compulsory and nationally mandated study modules required by the Malaysian Ministry of Higher Education.; Penghayatan Etika dan Peradaban / Bahasa Melayu Komunikasi 2; Falsafah dan Isu Semasa; Emotional Intelligence in Action; Kursus Integriti Dan Antirasuah; Social Innovation Project; Note; :; Students are requested to take Bahasa Kebangsaan A if they do not obtain a Credit for Bahasa Malaysia in SPM.; All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Specialisations; Genetics; Year 1; Molecular Biology Techniques and Applications; Stem Cell Biology

description.en: Our Master of Science degree programme offers a research-based curriculum that deepens your expertise in your chosen natural sciences field. Whether full-time or part-time, it immerses you in the intricacies of scientific inquiry. Through hands-on experience and close collaboration with esteemed faculty members, you will hone your critical thinking skills and nurture a lifelong passion for scientific exploration. Under the guidance of renowned faculty members, you will delve into specialised areas of study, gaining invaluable insights and mentorship. Engage in cutting-edge research across various biosciences domains, leveraging state-of-the-art facilities and advanced technologies to push the boundaries of knowledge. To ensure quality supervision, only a select number of students are admitted each intake. We recommend applying early to join our impactful community of research professionals.

curriculum.en: This Master of Science is designed to provide you with an in-depth understanding of your chosen area within the field of Science. You will engage in a rigorous curriculum that combines theoretical knowledge with practical applications, ensuring that you gain a comprehensive mastery of the subject matter.; In addition to acquiring subject-specific expertise, we place great importance on developing your leadership qualities. Through collaborative projects, interactive discussions, and experiential learning opportunities, we will nurture your leadership potential and empower you to become a capable leader in your field.; Research Methodology; Students are required to pass the following modules (6 credit hours) in the first year of their candidature:; Year 1; Research Method for Social Science (Core Module); Qualitative Research Methods / Quantitative Research Methods; Key Research Areas; At Taylor's University, we believe research can help shape the future. Our postgraduate research programmes cover a broad range of topics with the aim to help shape the future in the aspects of society, technology, economy, and environment.; Food Science and Nutrition; A far reaching area, this cluster seeks new insights into probiotics, live 'friendly' microbes that protect and prevent against disease, food supplements, nutraceuticals, encapsulation controlled release of food bioactive components and advanced processing technologies.; Health Sciences; This cluster encompasses research in infectious diseases which looks at disease causing agents and the drugs or chemicals that kill or slow them down. This cluster also addresses growing health problems in society especially molecular mechanism in the progression and treatment of diabetes and cancer.; Applied Biodiversity; This cluster investigates the use and conservation of biological resources. curriculum.ms: This Master of Science is designed to provide you with an in-depth understanding of your chosen area within the field of Science. You will engage in a rigorous curriculum that combines theoretical knowledge with practical applications, ensuring that you gain a comprehensive mastery of the subject matter.; In addition to acquiring subject-specific expertise, we place great importance on developing your leadership qualities. Through collaborative projects, interactive discussions, and experiential learning opportunities, we will nurture your leadership potential and empower you to become a capable leader in your field.; Research Methodology; Students are required to pass the following modules (6 credit hours) in the first year of their candidature:; Year 1; Research Method for Social Science (Core Module); Qualitative Research Methods / Quantitative Research Methods; Key Research Areas; At Taylor's University, we believe research can help shape the future. Our postgraduate research programmes cover a broad range of topics with the aim to help shape the future in the aspects of society, technology, economy, and environment.; Food Science and Nutrition; A far reaching area, this cluster seeks new insights into probiotics, live 'friendly' microbes that protect and prevent against disease, food supplements, nutraceuticals, encapsulation controlled release of food bioactive components and advanced processing technologies.; Health Sciences; This cluster encompasses research in infectious diseases which looks at disease causing agents and the drugs or chemicals that kill or slow them down. This cluster also addresses growing health problems in society especially molecular mechanism in the progression and treatment of diabetes and cancer.; Applied Biodiversity; This cluster investigates the use and conservation of biological resources. Application of this knowledge results in a more sustainable utilisation and protection of biological resources in areas such as environmental management, bioremediation, aquatic and plant biotechnology and industrial chemistry.; Hiring Graduate Students; More than 300 postgraduates have chosen Taylor's to fulfil their research aspiration. programmes.officialAcademicRequirement: Entry Requirements We offered two entry pathway for this PhD programme, which is normal mode and prior to publication mode. Our PhD by Prior Publication mode provides a unique pathway for you to achieve a Doctoral award based on your existing body of work. We recognise the value of your prior publications and include them as a significant part of your submission for the Doctoral award. Normal Mode Master's Degree Masters in the field of Science; OR Bachelor's Degree Passed Bachelor's degree in Science with min. CGPA 3.67 and registered as a Masters candidate and passed related qualifying assessment Other equivalent qualifications Any other equivalent qualification recognised by the Malaysian Government or accepted by the Taylor's University Senate and any of condition of the above would require student's research proposal to be approved.
programmes.officialLanguageRequirement: English Requirement for international students : IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 60 (Internet Based Test) (May join IEN preparatory course and achieve the IELTS score) The validity of the IELTS or equivalent is within 2 years from the date of the examination. Notes: [1] Bachelor's degree in Science candidates who are registered for master's degree programmes in Science may apply to convert to the doctoral degree programmes subjected to the following conditions: Within 1 year for full time and within 2 years for part-time candidates; Having shown competency and capability in conducting research at doctoral level through rigorous internal evaluation. Approval of the Taylor's University Senate. [2] All information is subject to change. The above entry requirements serve as a guideline. Readers are responsible to verify the information by contacting the university's Admissions Department. Prior Publication Mode You will need to fulfil one of the below: Obtain a master's degree in the field or related fields accepted by the HEP Senate Obtain other qualifications equivalent to a master's degree recognised by the Government of Malaysia Candidates without a related qualification in the field/s or working experience in the relevant fields must undergo appropriate prerequisite courses determined by the HEP In addition to the above criteria, those who want to join Doctoral Degree by Retrospective or Prior Publication mode must include the below to the formal application: Minimum of 5 publications or equivalent works in alignment with the theme of the specialisation; An executive summary of the above publications to demonstrate the applicant’s contribution to knowledge in the field; A list of scholarly published work; The minimum language proficiency of the candidates must be determined by the HEP consistent with applicable programme standards or based on the needs of the programme, i.e., learning outcomes and the medium of instruction. A Selection Committee must be established to review the formal application for PhD by Retrospective or Prior Publication and recommend to the Senate to obtain approval. Criteria for published works Published work must encompass high-quality journals, monographs, books, research-based chapters in books, electronic publications which have not been used to obtain other awards or deemed a part of those awards. The publications or productions must be published or produced within a period not exceeding ten (10) years from the date of submission. For the five (5) nominated publications or productions, the candidate must be the principal author or creator with the contributions of others clearly defined. Notes All information is subject to change. The above entry requirements serve as a guideline. Readers are responsible to verify the information by contacting the university's Admissions Department.

description.en: Our Doctor of Philosophy in Science is a research-based programme that offers an immersive research experience for those driven by a passion for discovery. As a doctoral candidate in the School of Biosciences, you'll collaborate with esteemed faculty members who are leading experts in their respective fields. Each intake welcomes a select cohort of students, maintaining a rigorous and personalised supervision process. Whether your focus is biotechnology, environmental science, molecular biology, or beyond, our faculty provides invaluable insights, mentoring your growth as an impactful researcher.

curriculum.en: Our PhD in Science programme is designed to develop graduates who possess a wide range of competencies. We are committed to equipping you with the skills and abilities to synthesise knowledge, adapt practical skills, conduct independent research, demonstrate leadership qualities, and critically appraise problems using scientific skills.; Throughout your studies, you will engage in advanced studies and research that will enable you to synthesise existing knowledge in your field of study. We emphasise the importance of staying abreast of the latest developments and trends in your discipline, allowing you to contribute to the expansion of knowledge in your area of expertise.; Duration; Full time; 3 - 6 years; Part time; 4 - 8 years; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Research Methodology; In their first year, students must complete the following modules (totalling 6 credit hours): Research Method for Science and either Qualitative Research Methods or Quantitative Research Methods.; Key Research Areas; At Taylor's University, we believe research can help shape the future. Our postgraduate research programmes cover a broad range of topics with the aim to help shape the future in the aspects of society, technology, economy, and environment.; Interested to know more?; Infectious Disease; The rich biodiversity of Malaysia enables the discovery of novel compounds to fight infectious diseases. At Taylor's University, the identified natural compounds will be examined for their bioactive properties as well as their mode of action. In addition to the antimicrobial research, the host-pathogen interaction research is focused to understand the disease manifestation in host cells.; Non-Communicable Diseases; Diet, smoking, alcohol consumption, a sedentary lifestyle and stress have contributed to greater incidences of heart disease, respiratory disease, diabetes and cancer, among others. Available drugs for these diseases are often accompanied by undesirable side effects, not selective enough or simply too expensive. Hence, this cluster targets the discovery of novel lead compounds and to scientifically validate natural remedies for lifestyle-related chronic diseases.; Environmental Research; Research conducted in this cluster focuses in bioremediation, taxonomic identification of marine flora and to facilitate the development of mechanisms or processes that are in compliance with environmental laws. It will target improvement in resources savings, waste disposal and resolving environmental stress issues. In addition, researchers in this cluster also provide consultation and training in environmental management systems.; Food Science And Nutrition; The broader aim of research in this cluster is to study the fundamentals and applied aspects of new functional foods, medical foods and nutraceuticals as well as new technologies that facilitate development of novel consumer products that enhance human health, food safety and functionality.; Hiring Graduate Students; More than 300 postgraduates have chosen Taylor's to fulfil their research aspiration. Join us and contribute to our innovative and progressive research projects; here.; Associate Professor Dr Mah Siau Hui​​, Programme Director; The program seeks to develop graduates with the competencies to synthesize new knowledge, conduct rigorous research independently, demonstrate leadership qualities and appraise problems critically using scientific skills.; VIEW ALL LECTURER; Associate Professor Dr Mah Siau Hui​​, Programme Director; The program seeks to develop graduates with the competencies to synthesize new knowledge, conduct rigorous research independently, demonstrate leadership qualities and appraise problems critically using scientific skills.; VIEW ALL LECTURER

Notes: [1] Bachelor's degree in Science candidates who are registered for master's degree programmes in Science may apply to convert to the doctoral degree programmes subjected to the following conditions: Within 1 year for full time and within 2 years for part-time candidates; Having shown competency and capability in conducting research at doctoral level through rigorous internal evaluation. Prior Publication Mode You will need to fulfil one of the below: Obtain a master's degree in the field or related fields accepted by the HEP Senate Obtain other qualifications equivalent to a master's degree recognised by the Government of Malaysia Candidates without a related qualification in the field/s or working experience in the relevant fields must undergo appropriate prerequisite courses determined by the HEP In addition to the above criteria, those who want to join Doctoral Degree by Retrospective or Prior Publication mode must include the below to the formal application: Minimum of 5 publications or equivalent works in alignment with the theme of the specialisation; An executive summary of the above publications to demonstrate the applicant’s contribution to knowledge in the field; A list of scholarly published work; The minimum language proficiency of the candidates must be determined by the HEP consistent with applicable programme standards or based on the needs of the programme, i.e., learning outcomes and the medium of instruction. A Selection Committee must be established to review the formal application for PhD by Retrospective or Prior Publication and recommend to the Senate to obtain approval. Criteria for published works Published work must encompass high-quality journals, monographs, books, research-based chapters in books, electronic publications which have not been used to obtain other awards or deemed a part of those awards. The publications or productions must be published or produced within a period not exceeding ten (10) years from the date of submission. For the five (5) nominated publications or productions, the candidate must be the principal author or creator with the contributions of others clearly defined. Notes All information is subject to change. The above entry requirements serve as a guideline. Readers are responsible to verify the information by contacting the university's Admissions Department.

description.en: Throughout the Bachelor of Business (Honours) programme, you will develop a comprehensive understanding of key business functions, from management to the marketing of goods and services. Designed to encompass every facet of business ownership and operations, our holistic learning modules will equip you to navigate the complexities of today’s dynamic business landscape with confidence and clarity. Whether you envision leading your own enterprise or making a meaningful contribution within a global organisation, this programme will empower you with the critical knowledge, strategic insight, and practical skills required to drive success. Given the strong interest from aspiring business leaders, we carefully select individuals who demonstrate the potential to make a real impact in the world of business. We invite you to submit your application early to take advantage of this opportunity to shape your future and begin your journey towards meaningful leadership.

description.en: Step into the world of global business and marketing with Taylor’s Bachelor of Business (Hons) in International Business and Marketing. This degree equips you with practical skills, international perspectives, and the confidence to work across borders. You will learn to think critically, communicate effectively, and solve real-world problems—preparing you to support businesses in strategy, branding, and market growth on a global scale.

curriculum.en: In this programme, you will build a strong foundation in business principles while developing specialised skills in international marketing. You will learn how to navigate global markets, understand diverse customer segments, and adapt marketing strategies across cultural contexts. The curriculum also trains you to conduct market research, analyse consumer behaviour, and create strategic marketing plans that meet real-world business needs. By focusing on both business fundamentals and cross-cultural marketing techniques, this degree prepares you to connect with international audiences and thrive in today’s competitive global landscape.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which are common modules that provides the fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Accounting for Non-Specialists; Introduction to Management; Business Economics; Principles of Marketing; Introduction to Finance; Quantitative Methods for Business; Human Resource Management; Year 2; Understanding Entrepreneurialism; Introduction to International Business; Consumer Behaviour; Marketing Analytics; International Finance; Integrated Marketing Communications; Export Practices and Management; Transnational Management; International Economic Theory and Policy; Interactive and Digital Marketing; Year 3; Strategic Management; International Trade and Multinational Business; Services Marketing; Strategic Marketing Capstone Project; Entrepreneurship Accelerator Project I; Internship/Industry Immersion; International Business Issues and Policies; International Marketing; Entrepreneurship Accelerator Project II; Contemporary Issues in Marketing; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; University Core; The Ministry of Education (MOE) requires all students to take Mata Pelajaran Umum (MPU) (i.e. General Studies) which is categorised under U1, U2, U3 and U4 within the duration of their studies. U1 modules are prescribed by MOE whereas U2, U3 and U4 modules are from a list of University Core Modules (UCM) prescribed as per the Programme Guide.; Penghayatan Etika dan Peradaban/ Bahasa Melayu Komunikasi 2; Falsafah dan Isu Semasa

Join our programme which offers exciting opportunities in the world of accounting and finance. Check out our entry requirements below. Prerequisites SPM/ O-Level with Pre-U/ Foundation Pass SPM/ O-Level or equivalent to 5 credits (including credits in Mathematics) for an entry with pre-university/ foundation qualification (except for UEC). SPM / O-Level with Diploma Pass SPM / O-Level or equivalent with 3 credits (including credit in Mathematics) for entry with Diploma and Advanced Diploma qualification. Note : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university. Entry Pathway Taylor’s Foundation Pass any Taylor's Foundation programme with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 Taylor's Diploma Pass Diploma in Accounting or related field with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan Malaysia (STPM) Minimum Grade C+ (GPA 2.33) in any two subjects Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) Pass with minimum 5Bs with a maximum 26 points including Mathematics. Candidates without a Grade B in UEC Mathematics may be admitted if the candidate has a credit in Mathematics at SPM or equivalent A Level Minimum DD AUSMAT (SACEi) Minimum ATAR 60 Canadian Pre-University (CPU) Minimum average of 55% in 6 subjects International Baccalaureate (IB) Minimum 26 points and above in 6 subjects Monash University Foundation Year (MUFY) Overall 60% Other Equivalent Qualifications Pass Business Foundation from other accredited institutions with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 Pass a Diploma in Accounting or a related field from an accredited institution with a minimum CGPA of 2.50. Candidates with a CGPA below 2.50 but more than 2.00 may be admitted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment Pass in Diploma (Level 4, MQF) with minimum of CGPA of 2.50 or Advanced Diploma (Level 5, MQF) in accounting or related field with a least a CGPA of 2.50 Other foundation, matriculation, high school certificates /diploma (Year 12) from other accredited institutions with a minimum CGPA of 2.50 Application via APEL A is allowed Note : Candidates with a pass in Mathematics at SPM level need to take and pass the enhancement Mathematics subject that equivalent to the SPM level. The enhancement Mathematics subject must be offered in first semester. Candidates without a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent may be admitted if the STPM / Matriculation / Foundation / Diploma / Advanced Diploma programme contains subjects in Mathematics that are equivalent and achieved higher at SPM level. All information is subject to change. The above entry requirements serve as a guideline. Readers are responsible to verify the information by contacting the Admissions Department.

description.en: This Bachelor of Accounting (Finance) (Honours) programme is designed to provide you with a comprehensive understanding of all areas of accounting and finance, with the goal of nurturing the next generation of experts in taxation, assurance, financial accounting, corporate finance, and financial management. A distinctive feature of this programme is the integration of the Bloomberg Market Concepts (BMC) certification within the Investment Management module. This certification offers students practical exposure to real-world financial tools and data analytics, enhancing their industry readiness and employability. Given the programme’s unique curriculum and the added advantage of industry-recognised certifications, early application is encouraged to secure your place and begin your journey towards making a meaningful impact in the field of accounting and finance.

description.en: Carefully designed to provide a comprehensive background in banking and finance concepts, this programme aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary for practical application in today's dynamic workplace by covering a wide range of topics including financial markets, investment analysis, risk management, banking operations, and regulatory frameworks. A distinctive feature of the programme is the integration of the Bloomberg Market Concepts (BMC) certification within the Portfolio Management module, offering students practical exposure to real-world financial tools and data analytics. This added dimension enhances their industry readiness and employability, making the programme especially attractive to those seeking to build expertise across key areas of banking and finance. To begin your journey towards a rewarding career in the financial sector, we encourage early application to ensure a seamless transition into this transformative academic experience.

curriculum.en: In the Bachelor of Banking and Finance (Honours) degree programme, you will embark on an exhilarating journey of unleashing your analytical skills to seek solutions through creative ideas. You will also polish your interpersonal and communication skills, empowering yourself for success in the dynamic realm of banking and finance.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which provide in-depth fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Introduction to Accounting; Introduction to Management; Business Communication; Business Economics; Introduction to Finance; Quantitative Methods for Business; Business Law; Year 2; Personal Financial Planning and Wealth Management; Bank Management; Money and Banking; Credit Management; Corporate Finance; Portfolio Management; Risk Management; Islamic Banking and Finance; Year 3; Ethics and Corporate Governance; Investment Management; Financial Economics for Contemporary Markets; Applied Econometric; Financial Markets; Derivatives; Internship; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; University Core; The Ministry of Education (MOE) requires all students to take Mata Pelajaran Umum (MPU) (i.e. General Studies) which is categorised under U1, U2, U3 and U4 within the duration of their studies. U1 modules are prescribed by MOE whereas U2, U3 and U4 modules are from a list of University Core Modules (UCM) prescribed as per the Programme Guide.; Penghayatan Etika dan Peradaban/ Bahasa Melayu Komunikasi 2; Falsafah dan Isu Semasa; Emotional Intelligence in Action; Kursus Integriti Dan Antirasuah; Social Innovation Project; Note; :

description.en: Throughout this Bachelor of Finance and Economics (Honours) programme, you will delve into a broad spectrum of topics such as capital markets, investment decision-making, option pricing, and macroeconomic analysis, equipping you with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills through hands-on modules.​ A distinctive feature of this programme is the integration of the Bloomberg Market Concepts (BMC) certification upon completing the Portfolio Management module. This certification provides you with practical exposure to real-world financial tools and data analytics, enhancing your industry readiness and employability. ​ Graduates will emerge with a profound understanding of economic and financial systems, prepared to navigate and influence the ever-evolving global financial landscape. Given the programme's unique curriculum and the added advantage of industry-recognised certifications, early application is encouraged to secure your place and begin your journey towards making a significant impact in the field of finance and economics.

Unravel the intricacies of option pricing, and gain insightful perspectives on national economies at a macro-economic level. description.en: This Bachelor of Actuarial Studies (Honours) programme equips you with a strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and financial theory to navigate complex financial and business environments. From risk assessment and insurance to financial planning and investment analysis, students are exposed to a wide spectrum of actuarial applications. With access to experiential learning opportunities that enrich your academic experience, you will graduate with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to make informed decisions in high-stakes, data-driven settings. For those aspiring to a future in financial risk management, insurance, or actuarial consultancy, early application is encouraged to ensure a smooth and purposeful start to this forward-looking academic journey.

curriculum.en: This degree programme is designed to equip you with powerful analytical problem-solving skills and specialised training in calculating and effectively managing financial risks for businesses. We're dedicated to enriching your learning experience by providing a range of captivating opportunities that will help you extract the utmost value from your actuarial science studies.; Primary Major; This component consists of Common Core subjects, which are common modules across a discipline that provides the fundamental knowledge of the discipline.; Common Core; Year 1; Programming; Microeconomics*; Calculus; Probability Theory*; Mathematics of Finance*; Advanced Calculus; Mathematical Statistics*; Introduction to Accounting; Year 2; Life Contingencies I*; Applied Statistical Methods*; Introduction to Finance; Life Contingencies II*; Corporate Finance*; Fundamentals of Linear Algebra; Macroeconomics*; Internship; Year 3; Simulation and Credibility Theory; Survival Models*; Derivatives; Stochastic Calculus for Financial Economics*; Stochastic Processes*; Risk Theory*; Project; Insurance Practices and Takaful; Notes; :; * Students are required to take the modules in order to obtain VEE credits from the Society of Actuaries (SOA), US.; All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; University Core; This component aims to develop critical thinking, build up social intelligence and cultivate civic responsibility as well as broaden cultural knowledge. These consist of compulsory and nationally-mandated study modules required by the Malaysian Ministry of Higher Education.; Penghayatan Etika dan Peradaban / Bahasa Melayu Komunikasi 2; Falsafah dan Isu Semasa; Emotional Intelligence in Action

description.en: If you learn best by doing rather than sitting through traditional classroom lectures, this programme is built for you. Drawing inspiration from Finland’s renowned Team Academy model, it offers a fully hands-on learning experience that places real entrepreneurial practice from day one. You won’t just analyse case studies. You’ll build your own business, test your ideas in the real world, and learn through trial, teamwork and action. From solving real challenges to pitching ideas, everything you do here shapes your mindset as a future entrepreneur. As part of your journey, you’ll also have the opportunity to receive funding support to kickstart your venture, turning your dream business into a reality while you’re still studying. With a highly personalised and team-based approach, this programme is for bold thinkers ready to turn ideas into action.

description.en: This Bachelor of Accounting with FinTech (Honours) programme is designed to prepare you for the future of finance by combining core accounting knowledge with emerging financial technologies. You’ll explore key areas such as financial and management accounting, audit and assurance, corporate governance, taxation, blockchain, financial innovation, and information systems. A distinctive feature of this programme is the integration of the Bloomberg Market Concepts (BMC) certification upon completing the Corporate Finance module. This gives you hands-on experience with industry tools and real-time data analytics, enhancing your career readiness. With a future-focused curriculum and industry-recognised certifications, this programme sets you apart—apply early and lead the next wave of financial transformation.

programmes.officialAcademicRequirement: Entry Requirements Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? Our programme offers an exciting opportunity for individuals passionate about the field of Master of Business Administration (MBA). To ensure a smooth admission process, please take note of our entry requirements listed below. Fulfilling one of the requirements listed below: Bachelor's degree in the field or related fields with CGPA above 2.75; OR Bachelor's degree in the field or related fields with CGPA between 2.75 and 2.50 with 2 years working experience and an interview; OR Bachelor's degree in the field or relevant fields with CGPA less than 2.5 and minimum 5 years working experience OR Accreditation of Prior Experiential Learning (APEL) in accordance to Malaysian Qualification Agency requirement and 2 years managerial/ supervisory experience; OR Other academic qualification that are equivalent to the above and recognized by the Malaysian Qualification Agency (MQA) and the Malaysian Ministry of Education.
programmes.officialLanguageRequirement: International Students IELTS 6.0 (May join IEN preparatory course and achieve the IELTS score). Accreditation of Prior Experiential Learning (APEL) The following criteria shall apply for working adults applying for Accreditation of Prior Experiential Learning (APEL): Applicants must meet the requirements set by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA) A minimum of 2 years' managerial or supervisory experience is required If Your Bachelor Degree Are From Different Fields 1. Students without a qualification in the related fields or relevant working experience requires to undergo and pass a bridging module. 2. Students without a qualification in the related field but with relevant working experience requires to fulfil the following conditions: CGPA above 2.50 must have at least two (2) years of relevant working experience; or CGPA 2.00 to 2.50 must have at least five (5) years of relevant working experience; 3. In addition, students will need to undergo a rigorous internal assessment Note : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.

description.en: Our highly sought-after Master of Business Administration (MBA) curriculum combines personalised leadership development with a strategic multidisciplinary approach, offering you a unique and comprehensive learning experience. This programme is crafted to provide you with a strong foundation in business knowledge, insights, and skills that are relevant and applicable across the globe. Whether your goal is to lead in a multinational corporation, launch your own startup, or create meaningful change in the public sector, our MBA equips you with the tools and perspectives needed to make an impact and succeed at the highest levels. What makes our MBA even more accessible is that it does not require prior work experience, making it the ideal opportunity for both aspiring professionals and those looking to fast-track their careers. Apply early to secure the skills and confidence needed to thrive in today’s competitive business landscape.

curriculum.en: If you are a working adult seeking to enhance your career prospects, the Taylor's MBA offers the flexibility and structure you need. With a minimum duration of 12 months, the programme is built to accommodate the demanding schedules of working professionals.; It is designed to address the latest challenges faced by businesses and incorporates up to date insights from industry experts. The elective courses are reviewed regularly to reflect current market trends, ensuring that you graduate with the most relevant knowledge and skills for today’s dynamic business landscape.; In addition, the; curriculum integrates Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles across various modules, giving you critical insights into sustainable and responsible business practices; .; Core (28 credits - 7 modules); Strategy & Innovation; Market Dynamics & Digital Disruption; Design Thinking; Business Analytics; Delivering Value to Customers; Managing People for Performance; Managing Decision; Note:; All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Elective Modules (4 credits - 1 module); You will need to choose 1 module from the list below:; Social Commerce and Digital Marketing; Money, Banking & Financial Markets; Leadership and Management of Change; Big Data in Digital World; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Project Modules (8 credits - 2 modules); Research Methodology for Executive; Business Management Project; Note; : Research Methodology for Executive is a prerequisite to Business Management Project.; Notes; :; Students are expected to complete 10 modules (7 core modules including 2 project modules and 1 electives) which will equal to 40 credits.; Students are allowed to enrol for a maximum of 20 credits in the long semester and a maximum of 10 credits in the short semester. However, a student must complete a minimum study period of one year for this programme.; Dr Christina Rathy Anthony Samy, Programme Director; Our Master of Business Administration strives to balance the constructs of theory, application, and practice while honing business skills to compete in a dynamic environment.; VIEW ALL LECTURER; Dr Christina Rathy Anthony Samy, Programme Director; Our Master of Business Administration strives to balance the constructs of theory, application, and practice while honing business skills to compete in a dynamic environment.; VIEW ALL LECTURER

description.en: The Master of Management programme is tailored for those who aspire to lead, manage, and innovate in today’s fast-paced business world. It equips you with essential management skills and strategic insights to excel in managerial roles across diverse industries. By blending theoretical knowledge with practical application, our curriculum helps you develop leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities to navigate complex business challenges and drive success. You can choose between two tracks: Consultancy or Entrepreneurship. The consultancy track offers hands-on projects with industry partners, allowing you to address real-world business challenges with innovative solutions while building valuable connections. Alternatively, the entrepreneurial track provides expert mentorship to help transform your inspiring business ideas into reality. Whether your goal is to take on senior leadership roles in multinational corporations or to lead your own business venture, this programme equips you with the expertise and qualifications to thrive in the field.

curriculum.en: The programme aims to enhance graduates' capabilities through strategic and critical thinking approaches to developing solutions, comprehensive knowledge in core areas of management, critical evaluation of evidence to support propositions, an application of competent management theories, principles and data, enhanced ability to synthesise ideas, theories and data, ethical work practices through sound corporate governance processes, and proficiency in conducting research and assessing information.; Core (7 modules); Strategic Management; Organisational Management; Leadership and Management of Change; Design Thinking; Leading Future Organisation; Project Management and Consultancy; Quality Management for Organisational Excellence; Note:; All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Elective Modules (1 module); You will need to choose ONE (1) elective from a list of modules which reflect contemporary trends in business:; Social Commerce and Digital Marketing; Marketing Management; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Research Project (2 Modules); Research Methodology for Executive; Business Strategy Project; Note; : Research Methodology for Executive is a pre requisite to Business Strategy Project.; Activities; Industry exposure opportunities offered throughout the duration of study.; Assessments; Written examinations; Presentation; Learning / Reflective Logs; Portfolios; Tests; Case Studies; Group Projects / Assignments; Projects; Note; : Students are required to achieve a minimum CGPA of 3.0 as part of the graduation requirement by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA).; Notes; :; Students are expected to complete 10 modules (7 core modules including 2 project modules and 1 electives) which will equal to 40 credits.; Students are allowed to enrol for a maximum of 20 credits in the long semester and a maximum of 10 credits in the short semester. However, a student must complete a minimum study period of one year for this programme.; Associate Professor Dr Arun Kumar Tarofder Rinku, Programme Director

description.en: Designed for driven professionals, this Master of Business Administration offers a flexible, fully online learning experience that equips you with strategic, leadership and business acumen — without putting your career on pause. It is ideal for those seeking to sharpen their decision-making skills, enhance their leadership capabilities, and build a strong foundation in global business strategy. You will engage with real-world case studies, industry-relevant projects, and a diverse academic and professional community, all from wherever you are. Whether you are preparing to step into a leadership role, change industries, or grow your own enterprise, this MBA provides the tools and confidence to thrive in today’s dynamic business landscape. Apply early to ensure a seamless start.

curriculum.en: Taylor's 100% Online MBA, offered by our AACSB-accredited business school makes this an ideal option for working adults like you who aim to meet the rigorous professional qualification standards required in today's business environment. It reflects the latest challenges facing businesses and up-to-date perspectives from our industry experts, the range of electives is revised based on market trends. This ensures that the curriculum is aligned with the management, leadership skills, and problem-solving capabilities, required for success in a global business context.; Core Modules; Strategy and Innovation; Business Analytics; Market Dynamics and Digital Disruption; Design Thinking; Managing Decisions; Delivering Value to Customers; Managing People for Performance; Research Methodology for Executive; Business Management Project; 1 Elective Module; Notes:; Research Methodology for Executive is a prerequisite to Business Management Project.; All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Elective Modules; You will need to choose ONE (1) elective from a list of modules which reflect contemporary trends in business:; The Art of Management; Project Management and Consultancy; Note; : All information is subject to change. Readers are responsible for verifying information that pertains to them by contacting the university.; Notes; :; Students are expected to complete 10 modules (8 core modules including 2 project modules and 1 electives) which will equal to 40 credits.; Students are allowed to enrol for a maximum of 20 credits in the long semester and a maximum of 10 credits in the short semester. However, a student must complete a minimum study period of one year for this programme.

description.en: Designed for ambitious professionals, this Master of Management offers a flexible, fully online learning experience that empowers you to build leadership, strategic, and organisational management capabilities — without putting your career on pause. The industry-relevant curriculum blends hands-on projects, case studies, and interactive discussions, ensuring students acquire cutting-edge industry insights with practical applications and develop the managerial acumen required to lead organisations in an era of rapid digital transformation. Whether you are an emerging talent or an early professional moving into a leadership role, growing a business, or switching industries, you will gain the strategic edge to lead, adapt, and make an impact. Apply early to ensure a seamless start.

programmes.officialAcademicRequirement: Entry Requirements Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? Our programme offers an exciting opportunity for individuals passionate about the Doctor of Business Administration (DBA). To ensure a smooth admission process, please take note of our entry requirements listed below. Fulfilling one of the requirements listed below: i. A Master’s degree (Level 7, MQF) in Business Administration, as accepted by the HEP Senate; OR ii. A Master’s degree (Level 7, MQF) in non-related fields, accepted by the HEP Senate, subject to having relevant working experience and rigorous internal assessment; OR iii. A Master’s degree (Level 7, MQF) in non-related fields, without relevant working experience, accepted by the HEP Senate, subject to passing prerequisite courses; OR iv. Other qualifications equivalent to a Master’s degree (Level 7, MQF) recognised by the Malaysian Government. Accreditation of Prior Experiential Learning (APEL) The following criteria shall apply for working adults applying for Accreditation of Prior Experiential Learning (APEL): All applicants are subjected to appropriate APEL assessments conducted by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA) The APEL provision is only to be applied to Malaysian nationalities Working Experience Experience can be cumulative experience even before acquiring required qualification for a particular level of study. However, the experience must be relevant to the level of study as well as the content. Rigorous Internal Assessment Rigorous assessment to evaluate the suitability of an applicant for a programme through statement of purpose, interview and other methods may cover the following criteria: Demonstration of strong business experience, and that you have held significant managerial responsibilities. Evidence of any achievements in your professional life, for example, consistently performing at a high level, consistent career progression and any impact that you have had on your organisation. Professional skills that you have developed, for example, teamwork, leadership, problem-solving, negotiating and analytical skills. How you will contribute to your class and what experiences you can bring to the institution. (Lancaster University, 2021) Prerequisite Courses The prerequisite courses must equip the applicant with necessary business knowledge of one level lower than the programme level: Managing People Managing Financial Resources Understanding Customers Understanding Environments and Strategic Planning

description.en: Designed for mid-level executives, senior leaders, and aspiring entrepreneurs, this programme offers an in-depth exploration of advanced business strategies, helping you elevate your strategic decision-making and leadership capabilities. It empowers you to tackle complex, real-world challenges with innovative, actionable solutions. Through collaboration with academics, industry experts, and goal-oriented peers, you will expand your global network while gaining the insights and expertise needed to address today’s business complexities. Whether you are aiming for senior leadership roles or seeking to drive transformative change in your own venture, this programme provides you with the qualifications and strategic vision to succeed in the global business landscape. Apply early to join our elite community of learners.
